compaction.title: Context compaction
compaction.hint: Global context policy shared by every agent and session. Changes apply to subsequent requests.
compaction.disabledWarning: Long conversations may fail when they exceed a model's hard context limit. Oversized tool results may still be trimmed.
compaction.presetHint: Start with a policy, then adjust individual values as needed.
compaction.presetPreserveHint: Keep more recent context for long, complex work.
compaction.presetEarlyHint: Reduce context sooner for frequent or cost-sensitive chats.
compaction.budgetPreviewHint: Illustrative global policy behavior for a model with a 128k context window.
compaction.budgetFormula: The trigger is the lower of the percentage threshold and the model window minus output reserve.
compaction.triggerThresholdHint: Automatically compact when the estimated full request crosses this percentage.
compaction.reserveTokensHint: Currently about {{tokens}} tokens reserved for the model response.
compaction.recentTurnsPreserveHint: Always keep at least this many recent user turns.
compaction.keepRecentTokensHint: Always keep approximately {{tokens}} recent tokens; the more conservative boundary wins.
compaction.retentionWarning: The retained context and output reserve approach the preview trigger. Compaction may have little removable history.
compaction.summaryModelHint: When unset, compaction follows the current session model and its configured fallbacks.
compaction.qualityGuardHint: Validate structured items and their citations to exact raw transcript records.
compaction.qualityGuardWarning: Disabling structure checks can make the handover fail when a model returns invalid JSON or source citations.
compaction.gapAuditHint: Run an independent second pass when the compacted records contain unresolved work, tool activity, failures, or exact identifiers.
compaction.advancedHint: Tune summarization execution and transcript safeguards. Defaults are recommended for most installations.
compaction.minMessagesBeforeCompactHint: Do not compact short conversations below this message count.
compaction.maxActiveTranscriptMbHint: Force compaction when the active serialized transcript exceeds this size.
compaction.summaryMaxTokensHint: Maximum output tokens for each merged continuation summary.
compaction.summaryChunkTokensHint: Target size of each transcript chunk sent to the summary model.
compaction.summaryTimeoutSecondsHint: With retries, one model may take up to about {{seconds}} seconds before fallback.
compaction.summaryRetriesHint: Additional attempts per summary model after the first failure.
compaction.minToolResultKeepCharsHint: Minimum retained preview when oversized tool results are reduced.
compaction.summaryBudgetWarning: The configured summary chunk and output may exceed this summary model's context window. Runtime clamping will reduce the chunk size.
compaction.postCompactionSectionsHint: After compaction, reload these Markdown headings from each agent's AGENTS.md. Missing headings are skipped.
compaction.postCompactionSectionsEmpty: No AGENTS.md sections will be reinjected after compaction.
compaction.postCompactionSectionsPlaceholder: Markdown heading, for example Red Lines
compaction.saveError: Failed to save context compaction settings
